displayName: jigak model refresh: job execution failed

documentation.content: A jigak-model-refresh execution ended in failure (exit 1 = crash, exit 2 = a model is at risk or expired, exit 3 = partial: at least one model failed, was closed or blocked). This fires on the first failed attempt; Cloud Run separately retries once (--max-retries 1), and a failed retry meets the condition again. Read the execution log in Cloud Logging and runs/<runId>/report.json in the models bucket. See jigak-backend/docs/MODEL-REFRESH.md.
